name: Satou Tadanobu
source:
Tsugunobu's younger brother and fellow vassal of first Lord Hidehira Fujiwara and later, Shanao. Brave to a fault, his presence on the battlefield always leaves his enemies defeated and his allies inspired.

Though not the sharpest tool in the shed, Tadanobu has a bright, charming personality, one that occasionally leads him to speak too plainly to Lord Shanao.
